instruction: Please initiate streaming of the video at this address: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_4x3/bipbop_4x3_variant.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (bipbop_4x3 variant) with rephrased instruction. Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator completely covers instruction requirements: checks both VLC playing state and URL match
Getter correctly extracts VLC status via HTTP interface (get_vlc_playing_info → status.xml)
Metric logic is robust with multiple URL matching strategies for HLS streams
Expected URL exactly matches the instruction URL
Data flow is semantically correct: status extraction → state+URL verification → pass/fail
Handles HLS stream edge cases where VLC may show filename instead of full URL
No postconfig needed - VLC HTTP interface continuously accessible during evaluation
